cards.answer: Zed is an AD-focused assassin whose shadows copy his shurikens and slashes. He dives onto a champion with Death Mark, then its delayed physical damage grows with the damage he and his shadows deal during the mark.
cards.counterplay: Track his shadow positions and limit his follow-up damage while marked.

cards.counterplay: Avoid lingering in basic attack range when low on health.

cards.answer: Razor Shuriken sends shurikens from Zed and his shadows, dealing physical damage through enemies. Each shuriken deals reduced damage after the first target it hits.
cards.counterplay: Dodge with the shadow firing angles in mind; use intervening units to soften incoming shurikens.

cards.answer: Living Shadow places a temporary shadow that copies Razor Shuriken and Shadow Slash; Zed can recast within range to swap places with it. Matching ability hits on the same target from Zed and a shadow, or from multiple shadows, restore energy, limited to once per cast.
cards.counterplay: Track the shadow as a possible swap destination and avoid overlapping ability hits.

citations.quote: Active: Zed sends a Shadow to the target location that will remain for a few seconds, being able to mimic his Razor Shuriken and Shadow Slash. Living Shadow can be recast while within range of the Shadow. Recast: Zed and the Shadow blink to swap places.

facts.claim: Living Shadow places a temporary shadow that copies Razor Shuriken and Shadow Slash; Zed can recast within range to swap places with it.

cards.answer: Shadow Slash deals physical damage around Zed and his shadows; shadow slashes also slow. Overlapping slashes strengthen the slow without adding damage. Zed's own slash reduces Living Shadow's remaining cooldown for each enemy champion hit.
cards.counterplay: Keep clear of shadow slash range and avoid clustering around Zed.

cards.answer: Death Mark makes Zed untargetable as he dives onto an enemy champion and marks them. The mark later detonates for physical damage that grows with the physical and magic damage Zed and his shadows deal during the mark. He leaves a shadow at his casting position that copies his shurikens and slashes, and can recast to swap back to it.
cards.counterplay: Save defensive tools for his follow-up after he reappears, and watch his return shadow.
